definition: To make a problem or bad effect less severe or serious.
summary: بقولها لما أخفف الضرر مش لما أحل المشكلة من جذرها
context: The CEO slammed the folder shut — the product launch was in 48 hours and the only way forward was to mitigate the damage before the press found out.
example: I'll mitigate the risk before we launch.

notes.grammar_note: فعل متعد `mitigate something` وما بياخدش حرف جر وغالبا مع `risk` و`damage`
notes.curiosity: كتير بيخلطوا بين `mitigate` و`eliminate` — الأولى تقلل الضرر لكن مش تلغيه وده فرق مهم في الشغل
common_examples: We mitigate the risk before we launch.
The new plan helps mitigate the damage to the brand.
